bind_address.description: IP address to bind the GKrellM server daemon to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#address 127.0.0.1).

bind_port.description: TCP port on which gkrellmd will listen for client connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#port 19150).

debug.description: debug (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#debug level 0x1).

fs_interval.description: fs-interval (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#fs-interval 2).

group.description: group (as documented in the shipped file).

inet_interval.description: inet-interval (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#inet-interval 1).

io_timeout.description: io-timeout (as documented in the shipped file).

max_clients.description: max-clients (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max-clients 2).

mbmon_port.description: mbmon-port (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#mbmon-port port-number).

net_timer.description: net-timer (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#net-timer ppp0).

nfs_interval.description: nfs-interval (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#nfs-interval 16).

pidfile.description: pidfile (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#pidfile /var/run/gkrellmd.pid).

reconnect_timeout.description: reconnect-timeout (as documented in the shipped file).

update_hz.description: update-hz (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#update-hz 3).

user.description: user (as documented in the shipped file).
